spans.s: (I)--the wife of Brahmadatta and mother of विष्- vaksena. भा. IX. २१. २५.

(II)--created from the belly and sides of the Lord; considered a part of Hari's body. As they supplied milk for हविस्, कंसा resolved to kill them. Nanda gave them as gifts to ब्राह्मणस् during कृष्ण's जातकर्मा.
